story_theme_en: The classroom temperature from Monday to Friday was: Monday 28 degrees, Tuesday 30 degrees, Wednesday 27 degrees, Thursday 32 degrees, Friday 29 degrees. What is the average temperature over the 5 days? Which day was the warmest?
helper_tip: Average = Sum / Number of items. Find the highest and lowest by comparing numbers.

visual_blocks.content: The classroom temperature from Monday to Friday was: Monday 28 degrees, Tuesday 30 degrees, Wednesday 27 degrees, Thursday 32 degrees, Friday 29 degrees. What is the average temperature over the 5 days? Which day was the warmest?

data.content_en: The classroom temperature from Monday to Friday was: Monday 28 degrees, Tuesday 30 degrees, Wednesday 27 degrees, Thursday 32 degrees, Friday 29 degrees. What is the average temperature over the 5 days? Which day was the warmest?

visual_blocks.title: Think
visual_blocks.content: Sum = 28+30+27+32+29 = 146 degrees | Average = 146/5 = 29.2 degrees | Warmest day = Thursday at 32 degrees

data.content_en: Sum = 28+30+27+32+29 = 146 degrees | Average = 146/5 = 29.2 degrees | Warmest day = Thursday at 32 degrees
